data.body: **[P2] Do not require transformed records to support `deepcopy` before exporter shaping.** Content and operation transforms may return JSON-serializable or custom-renderable values that reject `deepcopy`; before this PR those records reached `render()`/`export()`, but this path silently drops the entire record first. Isolate the built-in record containers without requiring opaque leaves to be copyable, or normalize through the exporter before copying, and test an uncopyable value that the renderer can successfully handle.
